title: Carports, patios, verandahs or equivalent structures built to the lot boundary
text: C3.4.3 Carports, patios, verandahs or equivalent structures are permitted to be built up to the lot boundary in accordance with Table 3.4b: Table 3.4b Carports, patios, verandahs or equivalent structures provisions: maximum length 10m; maximum wall height (1) 3m; maximum ridge height 4.2m; maximum pillar and posts horizontal dimensions 450mm x 450mm. (1) Measured to the top of pillar or post, refer Figure 3.4f. Note: Carports, patios, verandahs or equivalent structures will need to comply with the NCC requirements, including but not limited to fire separation and non-combustible materials. Pillars or posts located on the boundary with a horizontal dimension of 450mm or less are to be excluded from the calculations of boundary wall length.

parts.label: maximum wall height 3 m to top of post
posts not more than 450 mm x 450 mm

replaces.note: height 2.7 m -> 3 m; ridge 4.2 m added; 450 mm eave/gutter setback not carried

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: All four Table 3.4b limits must be met (literal values; table-3.4b is documentary). Posts on the boundary of 450 mm or less are excluded from boundary wall length. Not explicit that the structure must be behind the street setback (C3.3.4 governs carports). NCC fire separation applies. Uses proposed fact building.boundary_structure.present.
